مِرْآسٌ A horse that bites the heads of other horses when running with them in a race: (M, K: *) or [so in some copies of the K, but in others “ and, ”] that takes precedence of the other horses in a race. (K, * TA.) ―
-b2- See also رَؤُوسٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
